rateLimits.note: Free tier, per API key; custom use: higher limits by agreement. 429 on excess; repeated excess can bring a temporary or permanent ban.

provenance.notes: Rate limits read on docs.openaq.org (2026-11-10): 60/minute and 2,000/hour per user API key (free tier), headers x-ratelimit-used/-limit/-remaining/-reset, 429 on excess. Terms: an account and API key are required (key not transferable); attribution to OpenAQ as source required, and to the underlying providers (each location's licence, given by the API); higher-rate access under a paid API Licence and Services Agreement; the hosted API may not be used to build products that substantially duplicate or compete with OpenAQ; bulk downloading prohibited unless through registered, authorized use; do not leave requests running once data are no longer needed. Data licence varies per provider: licence null, commercial/storage/redistribution unknown. No published contact for API matters (DMCA policy only). No concurrency figure.
